Same model names (`gpt-6-astra`, `claude-opus-5-5`) at official endpoints get `windowSource: "official-model-docs"`, `windowAssumed: false`, populated sources; the same names at custom gateways get `windowAssumed: true`, `advertisedMaxOutputTokens: null`, `sources: []`, plus the "not applied to a custom endpoint" limitation. - **Req 2 (未知窗口保留未知):** Cases 5–6. An unknown model (`gateway-only-model-x`, absent from DOCUMENTED and LEGACY catalogs) resolves to `provider-default`/`windowAssumed: true`/`sources: []` at both official and custom endpoints — never fabricated into an official/certified window.
